purpose: Reusable brand assets for Minte.dev blog posts; copy into a post bundle when a topic materially discusses the brand.

assets.notes: Official Cloudflare favicon; use for compact references.
Photon Codes icon endpoint already used by the blog UI.
OpenAI 2025 logo sourced through Wikimedia Commons because openai.com blocks automated asset retrieval.

usage_rules: Prefer the exact repository-provided asset for Hermes and OpenMontage.
Use the smallest suitable asset for inline diagrams; use banner.png only for hero/reference treatments.
Keep brand assets under assets/brands/<brand>/ and copy only the assets used by a specific post into assets/posts/<slug>/ when publishing that post.
Keep source URLs in this manifest when adding future brands.
